## この表で分かること

図1～3と補足図S2で使う全102個のGAMを、図と同じ入力・単位・除外条件・設定で再推定します。
入力は `outputs/tables/bending.csv` と `tensile.csv`、出力は下記のCSVとRDSです。
データ統合を実行した後、プロジェクトのルートから `quarto render notebook/10-gam-results.qmd` で再生成できます。

モデルは「測定値 = 切片 + RWCの平滑関数 + 誤差」で、種・形質・曲げ方向ごとに独立に当てはめています。
Gaussian分布、identityリンク、平滑項は `s(RWC)` の既定値、平滑化パラメーターの推定はREMLです。
図3のみ、説明変数は曲げ・引張測定の平均RWCです。

* `n`：モデルに使った測定記録数
* `RWC min/max`：モデルに使った観測値の範囲（%）。この範囲を超える曲線は外挿です
* `edf`：平滑項の有効自由度。約1はほぼ直線です
* `F`、`Ref. df`：平滑項の近似検定統計量と参照自由度
* `p (raw)`：多重比較補正前のp値。RWCの平滑項が全体としてゼロという帰無仮説に対する近似検定です
* `Adjusted R²`：自由度調整済み決定係数

## Reading the results

All 102 GAMs underlying Figures 1–3 and S2 are refitted using the same inputs, units, exclusions, and settings as the figures.
Inputs are `outputs/tables/bending.csv` and `tensile.csv`; outputs are the CSV and RDS files below.
After data integration, run `quarto render notebook/10-gam-results.qmd` from the project root to regenerate them.

Each model is "response = intercept + smooth function of RWC + error", fitted separately by species, trait, and bending direction.
Models use the Gaussian family, identity link, the default `s(RWC)` specification, and REML for smoothing parameter estimation.
Only Figure 3 uses the mean RWC of the bending and tensile measurements as the predictor.

* `n`: number of measurement records used in the model
* `RWC min/max`: range of observed values used in the model (%); curves beyond this range are extrapolations
* `edf`: effective degrees of freedom of the smooth term; approximately 1 indicates a near-linear fit
* `F`, `Ref. df`: approximate test statistic and reference degrees of freedom of the smooth term
* `p (raw)`: p-value before multiple-comparison adjustment; an approximate test of the null hypothesis that the RWC smooth is zero throughout
* `Adjusted R²`: adjusted coefficient of determination

::::

```{r}
#| label: gam-summary
#| include: false
source("R/add_tensile_stiffness.R")
source("R/summarize_gams.R")
gam_results <- summarize_gams()
gam_table <- gam_results$table
stopifnot(nrow(gam_table) == 102L, !anyDuplicated(gam_table$model_id))
write.csv(gam_table, "outputs/tables/gam-results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(gam_results, "outputs/tables/gam-results.rds")
```

[CSV](../outputs/tables/gam-results.csv) · [RDS: models, table, versions](../outputs/tables/gam-results.rds) · [R code](../R/summarize_gams.R)

[Test definition: mgcv documentation](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/mgcv/html/summary.gam.html)

```{r}
#| label: gam-tables
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat("R ", gam_results$versions["R"], "; mgcv ",
    gam_results$versions["mgcv"], "\n\n", sep = "")
for (figure in c("1", "2", "3", "S2")) {
  cat("\n\n## Figure ", figure, "\n\n", sep = "")
  figure_data <- gam_table[gam_table$figure == figure, ]
  for (trait in unique(figure_data$trait)) {
    cat("\n\n### ", trait, "\n\n", sep = "")
    z <- figure_data[figure_data$trait == trait, ]
    display <- z[, c("panel", "species", "side", "n", "rwc_min", "rwc_max",
                     "edf", "ref_df", "F", "p_value", "adjusted_r_squared")]
    display$p_value <- format.pval(display$p_value, digits = 3, eps = 1e-16)
    names(display) <- c("Panel", "Species", "Side", "n", "RWC min", "RWC max",
                       "edf", "Ref. df", "F", "p (raw)", "Adjusted R²")
    print(knitr::kable(display, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
